budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Keep all three crew warm, manufacture three plates and two gaskets, install them into the rescue beacon, and operate it with at least two adjacent crew for three consecutive effective charge steps while the shared hearth has fuel.
task.natural_termination: Success when beacon charge reaches three and all warmth values remain positive; failure when any crew reaches zero warmth. Otherwise truncate at 192. Natural termination takes priority on the horizon step. Terminal raw calls preserve all state and clock and return zero reward.
task.interaction: Finite spatial deposits, six-unit bags, shared recipe buffers, cooperative labor, handoffs, shared hearth fuel, optional collective insulation investment, and two-person beacon operation create direct dependencies in resources, opportunities and timing.
task.observation_access: All dynamic variables needed for transitions are public in a fixed flat vector. Every role sees all entity positions and attributes. Observer identity is appended. Event/facing display fields are cosmetic records of transitions, not additional policy inputs.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Agent removed raw units from a finite deposit on this step
Agent transferred one item into infrastructure or hearth fuel on this step
Agent collected a manufactured plate or gasket on this step
Agent passed one carried item to a neighboring teammate on this step
Agent consumed one timber for an emergency warming fire on this step
Station completed one actual material transformation on this step
Shelter consumed one plate and one gasket to gain one insulation level on this step
Total completed metal plates and gaskets
Rescue beacon charged with all crew still alive

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
